candidates.statement: Order service postgres save_order fails with DependencyUnavailable while the connection pool is fully saturated (size 5, idle 0) across all sampled traces, causing order 503s, gateway ReadTimeouts and 502 checkout responses.
candidates.uncertainty: Pool size/idle are point-in-time; no postgres server-side metrics confirm saturation versus slow queries.

report.explanation: Checkout 502s align with order ReadTimeouts; order traces show postgres save_order DependencyUnavailable with pool size 5 and idle 0, and order metrics show 13.5/min 503s on /v1/orders. Deployment record only shows baseline v1.0.0 and does not establish causation.
missing_evidence: Postgres server metrics (active connections, max_connections, wait events) to confirm pool exhaustion
Order service logs for save_order failure detail
Order traces (excluded) to correlate pool state with latency
